subject: afl-dy
title: (R)AFL.DY.------IST.S.ALGN.------AF.DY.
description: Chart on book p. 471 (MP(I)-45). AFL-DY (affinity dynamics) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; IST-S-ALGN (isolated systematic alignment) and AF-DY (affinity dynamics), with the (C) prefix, "the concept of" are the partners in the title. From IST-S-ALGN: AF-DY and CUL-TR-S. From AF-DY: AFN (affinity negation). RT-OP (reality options) is on a dotted line from AF-DY. From CUL-TR-S: POL-DY (political dynamics). From AFN: INFO-F (information focus), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From POL-DY: RE-DOC (redocumentation), with the (P) prefix, "point of idea completion".
